hypothesis: Frozen disturbance may preserve noisy or obsolete acceleration throughout both-wheel dropout. Decay disturbance exponentially only when both wheels are missing/stale; keep normal wheel correction, adaptation and fault gates unchanged.
selection: At least 2% clean OR 5% fault-event group-macro RMSE gain relative to v5. Neither aggregate may regress >1%. No clean bag/receiver regression >max(0.01m/s,10%); no coverage loss, false-stop or unrecovered-fault increase. Scalar-span distance group macro must not regress >0.5%. v4 also reported.
data_policy: Reuse fixed v3 validation; no test measurements. Both GNSS receivers retained. Selection evidence, not independent test.
bound: Only tau 2s and 5s. No parameter sweep after seeing results in this hypothesis. Full-dataset clean and all four existing fault scenarios. Preserve failures.
